job_description: I know a guy who knows a guy.  Sometimes that guy needs to stop breathing.

description: Sachiko Imai wants Ryo Kurogane dead.  Go to the building she described and find him.  Step 1 of 3: find the target.  Step 2: kill him.  Step 3: report back to Sachiko.

effect.u_message: You are close.  Ryo Kurogane should be somewhere in here.

description: Ryo Kurogane is in this building.  Kill him.  Step 2 of 3.

effect.u_message: Ryo Kurogane is dead.  Go back and tell Sachiko.

description: Return to Sachiko Imai and tell her it is done.  She will pay you 1000 yen.  Step 3 of 3.

dynamic_line.yes: Good, you're awake.  Don't make that face; the walls here are thin and the neighbours talk.  You look like someone who needs money, and I happen to need someone who doesn't ask questions.

no.yes: Back already?  Tell me you have news.
no.no: We're square.  If I need something else done, I'll find you.

responses.text: It's done.  Ryo Kurogane is dead.

dynamic_line: A runner called Ryo Kurogane skimmed from the wrong people and now it's my name on the debt.  He's gone to ground <global_val:trl_target_dir>.  Ground floor, probably, he likes the exits.  Find him, kill him, come back and tell me.  I pay a thousand yen, cash.

responses.text: A thousand yen.  I'll do it.

dynamic_line: Good.  Check your mission log if you lose track: three steps, find him, kill him, tell me.  He carries a blade and he is not stupid.  Don't die; I don't pay the dead.
Ryo Kurogane.  He's holed up <global_val:trl_target_dir>.  Find him, kill him, come back.
Then that's the end of it.  Here: one thousand yen, as agreed.  Nice and untraceable.
